paragraphs: A tenzies dice game web application where players race to match all ten dice as fast as possible.

This project is a browser-based tenzies game where players race to match all ten dice by rolling them, holding the dice values they want to keep, and continuing until every die displays the same number. It is built with React, JavaScript, and CSS, uses Vite as the build tool, and is deployed on Netlify for cloud hosting. The game allows players to compete against others or try to beat their own best time and roll count, which are tracked on a personal scoreboard and saved between visits.
